items.title: Ayat Seribu Dinar (QS. At-Talaq 65:2-3)
items.latin: Wa may yattaqillaha yaj al-lahu makhraja. Wa yarzuq-hu min aisu la yahtasib, wa may yatawakkal alallahi fa huwa hasbuh, innallaha baligu amrih, qad ja alallahu likulli syai in qadra.
